source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1]
    v_separators = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    if separators:
        cut = min(separators, key=lambda i: abs(i - (h - 1) / 2))
        a, b = grid[:cut], grid[cut + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:n], b[:n]
    else:
        cut = min(v_separators, key=lambda j: abs(j - (w - 1) / 2))
        n = min(cut, w - cut - 1)
        a = [row[:n] for row in grid]
        b = [row[cut + 1:cut + 1 + n] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    base = Counter(v for row in a for v in row if v in common).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
'''
